checks.evidence: No api.txt, SDK or Cargo.toml change in the diff. The presence fold owns its tables by value and consumes GraphPresence into the region table (execution_domain/src/domain/executable_program/presence/service.rs:280-308). FilePresence is a plain field of FileRun that reuses its buffers each file (file_execution/presence/service.rs:147-174). The new RefCell fields follow RuntimeState's existing &self design (runtime/service.rs:169-177). NotesError reaches ProjectError through a typed From (languages/rust/src/outbound/notes/errors.rs:11-18). The per-file clones are advisories in the report.

execution_domain/src/domain/operator/contract/service.rs:230 ends failure() with `_ => RowFailure::Never`. Presence soundness depends on every operation declaring the rows that can fail it: an undeclared row-fallible operation lets a region publish the empty table where its full run reports an error. With the wildcard, a new Operation variant defaults to Never, and only a hand-maintained test census catches it (presence/service_test.rs:517-560 and :684-705, every_fault_has_a_verdict). An exhaustive match would make the compiler require the choice, as presence() (service.rs:174-191) and invalid_patterns (presence/narrowing.rs:96-124) already do.

The per-row presence loop allocates nothing: rows read into the reused cells buffer, tests are retained in place, and scratch and memo are taken from the file (file_execution/presence/service.rs:278-337). Maps in the runtime are FxHashMap (state/service.rs:190). The fold's std HashMaps run once per request at compile, not per file (presence/types.rs:145-160). The per-file reader-table walk replaces the per-request memo, and its cost is measured in evidence/perf/p7/after.json under the perf rule.

Column-origin propagation now has one definition, output_origins (operation_schema/projection.rs:134-233). trust/reads.rs:71-82 calls it in place of its own copy. tree_output (projection.rs:103-124) replaces the inline copy in file_program/service/operators.rs:96-99. RegionCount moved from readiness to executable_program/types.rs:12 and was not duplicated. AbsentRoots is a newtype over AbsentRegions (file_demand/types.rs:118).

No dependency change in the diff. The AbsentRegions bitset (file_demand/types.rs:136-166) is 30 lines of glue, like the existing ReadinessBits (values/src/domain/records/types.rs:307), and no bitset crate is in the lock.

The provider-alias fixes name their cases in the commit messages (a33a4c13f1, 6e7265eaac). Red then green is recorded at README.md:78: compile reds without the scope field, plus behaviour reds on the plant and on the tm built from 0f2fa35a12. 28efeb7bf0 is a compile repair. The skip rules and the noqa rewrite follow the perf rule (evidence/perf/p7/after.json, perf/noqa-fragments/after.json). Three changes are stated with reasons. The memo test was removed with the memo in c84c355dfb. The target-supplement validator change states its reason, still refuses any non-selected row that is not FAIL, 'not selected', 0 cases (target_supplement.py:17-27), and two reds stay named in 5339ed5df3. The removed asymptote.json hook test went with its mechanism (5e2aad3bf1). The diff adds no skip, ignore or wall-time assertion.

No unsafe and no production unwrap or expect in the diff. The only allow is test-side and carries a reason (execution/.../conformance/fixtures.rs:47-50). The compile-time check is a debug_assert (executable_program/service.rs:245-251). The rest is checked lookups returning OperatingError::NotRun.

findings.required: Replace `_ => RowFailure::Never` with an exhaustive list of every Operation variant (Project, Extend, Union, Intersection, Difference, Antijoin, GroupCount, GroupDigest, Capture, Rank, Words, Closure, Cycles, Rows, Hosted => RowFailure::Never), as invalid_patterns does, so that a new operation cannot compile without a row-failure declaration.
